title: move(drag=...) drags a creature the mover isn't grappling

history.reason: This fix also makes tests/srd/test_glossary.py::test_cant_drag_a_creature_someone_else_grapples (T-3) pass, and it now fails as a strict XPASS. Please remove its xfail marker too and close T-3 as fixed by this change, since the rule is the same: only the grappler can drag.
harness gap, not a test problem: the fix also fixed T-3; the harness now closes co-fixed tickets

history.summary: I fixed T-2. When `drag=` is given, `combat.move` now checks that the mover is one of the target's grapplers before anything else happens. That means a Grappled effect on the target with `grappler == mover.id`. If not, it refuses with page=182 and nothing moves or changes. The ticket's test passes with --runxfail. So does T-3's `test_cant_drag_a_creature_someone_else_grapples`, because it's the same rule; without --runxfail both show as XPASS(strict) until the harness drops their markers. The tag is SRD[GLOSS.grappled#3]. I added three unit tests in tests/unit/test_combat.py: a refusal when the target isn't grappled, a refusal when someone else is the grappler, and a successful drag by the real grappler. Unit tests: 153 passed. Glossary suite with --runxfail: 27 passed. ruff check and ruff format --check are clean, and dev-gate passes.
